opening_line: Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank, and we record this call. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?

questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?

lines.first_ask_one: Can you make this payment today?
lines.first_ask_many: Can you pay all of them today?
lines.text_sms: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.paid: Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.sympathy: I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.person_first: I can help you with most questions. Can I help you first?
lines.change_promise: You can change a recorded promise in the mobile app.

close_promise: Your promise is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
close_paid: Payments can take one business day to appear. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
close_restructuring: I will connect you with a colleague now. Thank you, goodbye.
close_human: I will connect you with a colleague now. Thank you, goodbye.
close_support: I will connect you with our customer support team now. Thank you, goodbye.
close_refused: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
close_hardship: Thank you for your time. Take care. Goodbye.
close_dispute: I understand. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
close_service_error: I am sorry, I could not record the promise. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
close_failed: I am sorry, I cannot continue. Please use the mobile app or visit a branch. Thank you, goodbye.
close_declined: I understand. I cannot continue without the security questions. Thank you, goodbye.
close_callback: Thank you, we will call back then. Goodbye.
close_no_callback: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
close_wrong_number: I am sorry for the trouble. Thank you, goodbye.
close_deceased: I am sorry for your loss. Thank you, goodbye.
close_unclear: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
